title: Vietnam — entry requirement
text: Records supplied: 1 of 1 weather notes, 1 of 1 transit options. Visa requirement on record: eVisa. Entry notes: Single and multiple entry eVisa applied for online before departure. Carry a printed copy of the approval letter.

title: Vietnam — weather: Winter (Dec-Feb)
text: Season: Winter (Dec-Feb). Cool and drizzly in Hanoi and the north while the south stays hot and dry - pack for both climates.

title: Vietnam — transit: rail
text: Transit type: rail. The Reunification Express runs Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh City. Book soft sleeper berths several days ahead.
